scripts.build: npm run design && npm run build -w @cmori/skyscope-core -w @cmori/skyscope-tokens -w @cmori/skyscope-render -w @cmori/skyscope-sources -w @cmori/skyscope-react -w @cmori/skyscope-source-template && npm run bundle:blazor
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b ts/packages/core ts/packages/render ts/packages/sources ts/packages/react ts/packages/blazor ts/packages/source-template
scripts.bundle:blazor: tsc -b ts/packages/core ts/packages/render ts/packages/sources ts/packages/blazor && esbuild ts/packages/blazor/src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap --outfile=dotnet/Mori.SkyScope.Blazor/wwwroot/skyscope.js
